== Editing ==
English Decipher-era comparison for [[Bacta Tank]]. Columns cover distinct published text states in date order; the stamp row describes the displayed rendition. Japanese and Virtual printings remain in Versions; a Revised, Unlimited or foil reprint whose printed words differ is a column. Yellow highlights mark changed words against the column before.
